How it works

Pick a stage. Color. Grow.

Every stage is a new set of art tools to master. Kids color at their own pace — progress is gentle, never gated by timers or scores.

1

Pick a stage

Start in Stage 1 with chunky crayons. Each new stage introduces a new tool — pencils, markers, watercolors, glitter pens, stamps and more.

2

Color the page

Tap a color, tap a shape — every shape is fully closed, so color lands exactly where it belongs. Zoom in up to 500% for the tiny details, and hear a “Did You Know?” fact about every picture.

3

Sign it & save it

Finished paintings get the artist's own signature in the corner and are kept safe in the app's Gallery, ready to show off or share with family.

4

Unlock the next stage

Finish any 6 pages in a stage and the next stage opens — the remaining 4 become bonus pages. Finish all 10 and the stage earns its gold “Stage Complete” badge.

The journey

10 stages, 10 pages each

Each stage feels like opening a brand-new art box. Tools are always labeled by color name — never numbers — so young artists learn real color words as they play.

STAGE 1

Crayons

The perfect first art box. Big, friendly pages and chunky crayon colors — free for everyone, forever.

STAGE 2

Colored Pencils

A step up in control. Pencils reward careful coloring and introduce finer details and shading.

STAGE 3

Markers

Bold, bright and confident. Marker pages are made for big color and happy, saturated pictures.

Gift inside: the sparkly Glitter Brush unlocks here
STAGE 4

Watercolors

Soft washes and gentle blends. Watercolor pages teach a lighter touch and dreamy skies, seas and fields.

STAGE 5

Pastels

Powdery, chalky and calm. Pastel stages bring softer palettes and cozy, quiet pictures.

STAGE 6

Stickers

Color first, then decorate! Sticker pages let artists finish their work with fun sticker details.

STAGE 7

Gel Pens

Smooth, shiny gel color with fine lines — great for patterns, outlines and little sparkling touches.

STAGE 8

Glitter Gel Pens

Everything glitters. The most magical box in the studio, full of shimmer and shine.

STAGE 9

Stamps

Stamp, pattern and repeat. Stamps turn coloring pages into playful designs full of texture.

STAGE 10

Master Studio

The grand finale — every tool learned along the way, and the studio's most special pages, reserved for artists who made it all the way.

Peek inside

Pages that start as outlines…

Every page begins as clean black line art with fully closed shapes, so even the youngest artist can tap and fill with confidence.

Inside the studio

Little details, thoughtfully made

“Did You Know?” on every page

Every one of the 100 pages — and all 30 Parent Pack pages — comes with a short fun fact, read aloud in a friendly story voice. Kids color and learn at the same time.

Music made for the studio

A welcome song greets artists at the door, and five gentle background tracks play while they color. Music volume and story-voice volume are separate, so parents can set each one just right.

Zoom up to 500%

Tiny butterfly wings? Little fish scales? Every page zooms right in, so small hands can color small details without frustration.

A Gallery that keeps everything

Paintings live in the app's own Gallery — never scattered across your camera roll. A storage meter shows how much room is left, and parents can select and tidy up old paintings anytime.

Signed like a real artist

Every finished painting carries the artist's signature in the bottom-right corner, with a size adjuster so it never covers the picture.

A fresh showcase every day

The welcome screen shows ten pages — one from every stage — and the set changes daily, so there's always a new picture calling your child's name.

Parent packs

Three extra packs — parents decide

Beyond the 100 stage pages, three themed packs of 10 pages each are built in. They are switched off by default — a parent turns on only the ones right for their family.

Bible Stories

Gentle scenes from well-loved Bible stories, drawn for young children to color and talk about together.

10 pages

Mythical Creatures

Unicorns, dragons and other friendly make-believe friends from the world of storybooks.

10 pages

Super Heroes

Brave, kind-hearted heroes on cheerful adventures — capes, courage and helping others.

10 pages

Good to know: the ten main stages contain no Bible pages at all. Faith-based pages live only in the Bible Stories Parent Pack, and only appear when a parent switches that pack on.

For parents

Made for ages 3–8, with parents in charge

Built for little hands

Big tap targets, color names instead of numbers, fully closed shapes so filling always works, and deep zoom for details — designed from the start for children ages 3 to 8.

Progress without pressure

Six finished pages open the next stage; the other four stay as bonus pages, so no child is ever stuck. Gold “Stage Complete” badges celebrate finishing all ten.

You're in control

Parent Packs start switched off. Story voice and music each have their own volume. Paintings stay inside the app's Gallery on your device, with a storage meter and easy tidy-up tools.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Is My Little Studio free?

Yes — you can open the web version and start coloring right away, and Stage 1 (Crayons) is free. The Google Play app, coming soon, will also be a free download with Stage 1 included; one in-app purchase will unlock the remaining stages and packs.

What ages is it for?

My Little Studio is designed for children ages 3 to 8 — simple tap-to-fill coloring and big shapes for the youngest artists, with finer details, more tools and deeper zoom as stages progress.

How do new stages unlock?

Finish any 6 of the 10 pages in a stage and the next stage opens. The remaining 4 pages become bonus pages — nothing is ever lost. Finish all 10 pages in a stage to earn its gold “Stage Complete” badge. A special Glitter Brush gift also unlocks at Stage 3.

What are Parent Packs?

Three optional sets of 10 pages each — Bible Stories, Mythical Creatures and Super Heroes. They are switched off by default, and a parent chooses which ones to turn on. The ten main stages contain no Bible pages.

Where do my child's paintings go?

Finished paintings are saved in the Gallery inside the app, on your own device — not in your camera roll. The Gallery shows a storage meter, and you can select and delete paintings whenever you like. In the installed app, paintings can also be shared with family through the phone's own share sheet.

Does it work on iPhone and iPad?

Yes. Open the studio in Safari and it runs right in the browser. To keep it on the home screen like an app, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen.” On Android Chrome and desktop Chrome or Edge, use the green “Install app” button on the welcome screen instead.

When is the Google Play version coming?

It's in preparation now — the app has been created in Google Play Console and is being finished as a native app for children ages 3–8. Until it launches, the web version above is the full studio, free to play.

Who makes My Little Studio?

My Little Studio is made by Studio85. Questions, ideas or a painting you're proud of? Write to us any time at hello@mylittlestudioapp.com or support@mylittlestudioapp.com.
